CI/CD Pipeline Integration
1. Integrate IaC security scanning into its CI/CD pipeline:
- Developers commit changes to the IaC templates in the Git repository.
- The CI/CD pipeline automatically triggers upon new commits.
- The pipeline runs automated security checks using tools like Checkov and Terrascan.
- If security issues are detected, the pipeline fails and notifies the development team.
- Once all checks pass, the changes are approved and applied to the respective cloud environments.
